_source: Real placement captured 2026-07-22 from IM Sports (Sunflower 2.0). A pre-match 让球 -0.5 @ 0.90 bet, stake 1 USD, placed via the venue's own signed calls (the venue was in one-click bet mode). Documents the exact GetBI + SPB request/response the site sends.
_notes: Both calls are ordinary JSON POSTs; the ONLY thing our code cannot reproduce is the per-request x-sc signature (see docs/plans/2026-07-22-imsb-live-protocol.md). The venue signs its own calls, so placement must be triggered through the site (DOM), not a bare fetch.
GetBI request wss[0] matches imsb-api.buildPlaceExpression's gbi exactly.
SPB request `ws` has NO hs/as (score) — a pre-match bet omits them. buildPlaceExpression was corrected to match.
SPB response: wid = 投注编号 (bet id), ao = accepted odds, ab = balance after. interpretPlaceResult maps wid/ao/ab -> {bet_id, accepted_odds, balance}.
